value: Pradyut Bordoloi, elected from Nagaon in 2024, resigned his Lok Sabha seat with effect from 20 March 2026; the Speaker announced acceptance on 24 March. He was elected to the Assam Legislative Assembly from Dispur in May 2026. The Lok Sabha Secretariat lists Nagaon among the vacant constituencies of the 18th Lok Sabha. The Election Commission has notified a bye-election (Notification No. 100/AS-HP/1/2026, 9 September 2026), with polling on 6 October 2026 and counting on 9 October 2026.
source_name: Lok Sabha Secretariat - vacant constituencies of the 18th Lok Sabha (official)

value: Jennifer Monserrate, the member for Taleigao (Assembly constituency 12), died on 19 July 2026. The Goa Legislative Assembly's members page records her as deceased (Bulletin No. 272), and no bye-election has been announced.
source_name: Goa Legislative Assembly - Members of the Eighth Legislative Assembly (official)

value: Ravi Naik, the member for Ponda (Assembly constituency 21), died on 15 October 2025. The Election Commission scheduled a bye-election for 9 April 2026 but rescinded its notification on 8 April 2026, after the High Court of Bombay at Goa declared the notification null and void. The Goa Legislative Assembly's members page records the member as deceased (Bulletin No. 236).
source_name: Election Commission of India - Notification No. 100/GOA-LA/1/2026 dated 8 April 2026, rescinding the Ponda bye-election (via CEO Goa)

value: Chhotelal Verma, the member for Fatehabad (Assembly constituency 93), died on 24 September 2026. No by-election had been announced when this page was last checked.
source_name: ThePrint (PTI) - BJP MLA passes away, Chief Minister Adityanath expresses grief (24 September 2026)

value: Danam Nagender, elected from Khairatabad in 2023, was held disqualified under the Tenth Schedule by the High Court for the State of Telangana on 18 September 2026, with effect from 23 April 2024; the Supreme Court upheld the ruling on 24 September 2026. The Assembly Secretary has notified the seat as vacant since 23 April 2024. No by-election had been announced when this page was last checked.
source_name: Telangana Today - Supreme Court upholds Danam Nagender's disqualification as MLA (24 September 2026)
